full_judgment: 4. The trial Court, on consideration of evidence adduced by both the parties, though found that the defendant was a defaulter tenant and also found that the defendant owed Tk.61,600/- to the plaintiff on account of arrear rents, but dismissed the suit holding to. the effect that the suit for ejectment of tenant was not maintainable 'in regular Court, it should have been instituted in the Small Causes Court; the trial Court observed also that the claim of the plaintiff for arrear rents of Tk.61,600/- became barred by limitation.
